About the Hall

Lahore Castle Banquet Hall is located in Block D1, Nespak Housing Society, on Sutlej Avenue, Lahore — an easy-to-reach residential area for families across the city.

The hall is double-storey and can host up to 600 guests, making it a practical choice for large family events. Separate arrangements for ladies and gents make it especially suitable for traditional family functions.

The venue hosts weddings and marriage gatherings, as well as school functions and Islamic functions. For date availability and booking details, call the hall directly or send a WhatsApp message.

Events We Host

From family weddings to school and religious functions — one hall, arranged the way your event needs.

Weddings

Barat, walima and full wedding events for up to 600 guests, with separate ladies and gents arrangements across two storeys.

Marriage Gatherings

Mehndi, nikkah gatherings and family marriage get-togethers in a comfortable, family-friendly setting.

School Functions

Annual days, prize distributions and other school functions with room for students, parents and staff.

Islamic Functions

Mehfil-e-Milad, religious gatherings and Islamic functions — the ladies/gents separation suits pardah-friendly events.
